strings.str_hsim_us_g_01_briefing.html_4: There were unacceptable casualties while fast-roping.
strings.str_hsim_09_after_pla_1: Actually, can I ask Smooth something?
strings.str_hsim_09_after_swa_0: Good job out there, Larkin. Hell, you nearly convinced me to buy you a beer sometime.
strings.str_hsim_09_after_pla_2: What did you feel when you took that guy down?
strings.str_hsim_09_after_swa_1: Return the bird at our base and don't worry about McNeal. He'll be ok. Stay safe.
strings.str_hsim_08_suspect_pla_0: Henderson, I see a man hijacking a car. I think it might be one of the suspects. It's near the corner of the main street.
strings.str_hsim_08_suspect_swa_0: TEC71, this is TEC40. Larkin has a suspect near the corner of the main street.
strings.str_hsim_07_ambient_takedown_ele_0: Hands, hands! Lemme see your hands! Suspect neutralized! Get down! Down, down on the ground! Right Now!
strings.str_hsim_07_ambient_takedown_swa_1: TEC71, this is TEC40. We are code 4. All clear.
strings.str_hsim_06_rope_pla_0: The wind is pretty strong. Be careful on the rope.
strings.str_hsim_06_rope_pla_1: Just go. I can't keep it steady in this wind.
strings.str_hsim_06_rope_ram_0: This is TEC43, this is TEC43. I need an RA unit at the target building. Officer down, I repeat: officer down.
strings.str_hsim_06_rope_swa_0: GO, GO, GO. Larkin, you stay on overwatch.
strings.str_hsim_06_rope_swa_1: Officer down, officer down! McNeal fell off the rope. Element, stack up. Ramirez, stay here with McNeal.
strings.str_hsim_05_stress_smo_1: Eyes on Target - do I have a green light?
strings.str_hsim_05_stress_swa_0: Larkin, get us there now! Element, get ready.
strings.str_hsim_04_ambient_flight_smo_0: Suspect's turning and leaving. You're clear, TEC40.
strings.str_hsim_04_ambient_flight_swa_0: TEC71, this is TEC40. Get the news chopper out. They're getting too close.
strings.str_hsim_03_arrival_smo_0: TEC40, this is Smooth. Welcome to the scene. Patching video feed... now.
strings.str_hsim_03_arrival_swa_0: Good, show us what you've got, Larkin.
strings.str_hsim_02_briefing_pla_1: No, not particularly. But I like the bird. Have you tested it in strong winds - like today?
strings.str_hsim_02_briefing_pla_2: Good thing you mentioned it. I'm concerned about the wind.
strings.str_hsim_02_briefing_swa_0: Lieutenant Henderson, TEC 30 team leader. You're the pilot? Well... ok. We'll have to make do - I hope you're as good as Andrews says.
strings.str_hsim_02_briefing_swa_1: Anyway, you'll have a chance to fly our brand new chopper. Like it? We just finished the stickers. Y'see, they wouldn't probably let us just waltz in with a Sheriff sign written all over it, right?
strings.str_hsim_02_briefing_swa_2: ...You don't have much to say for yourself, huh?
strings.str_hsim_02_briefing_swa_3: Yeah, we've been running some tests in extreme weather conditions. It runs pretty smoothly. Enough talking, let's go and see the situation Downtown.
strings.str_hsim_02_briefing_swa_4: Team, listen up. Suspects are holding a group of hostages in the last floor of the building. Larkin here will be our pilot for today.
strings.str_hsim_02_briefing_swa_5: We'll approach the building from an unsighted angle, using buildings as cover. Smooth will provide cover and video feed from the opposite building. We'll need to get there fast and unseen.
strings.str_hsim_02_briefing_swa_6: Larkin, you're flying with the FRIES for the first time, right? Let's hope you'll get us there safe.
strings.str_hsim_01_situation_pla_1: Well... Ok. Yeah, I'll do it.
strings.str_hsim_01_situation_sec_0: Yeah, sure. He could do it. Ah, yup, he's coming. I'll tell him right away. I'll let you know if he's interested. Thanks, Frank.
strings.str_hsim_01_situation_sec_1: Hey, son. Just got a call from Frank Andrews. He works with the TEC30 unit. They have a problem Downtown. Hostage situation. You in?
strings.str_hsim_01_situation_sec_2: Thing is, they have a brand new utility chopper; what's more, their pilot is injured and they need a reliable replacement.
strings.str_hsim_01_situation_sec_3: You need to act quickly, Tom. They only call me when they're in a jam - no time for long decisions.
strings.str_hsim_01_situation_sec_4: Now, that's my boy! Your father would be real proud of you, son.
strings.str_hsim_01_situation_sec_5: Go and pick up Lieutenant Henderson. He's waiting for you. He'll be, um, happy to see you.
strings.str_hsim_us_mil_02_sum: Punch into enemy territory, maintain formation with your commander and engage marked targets.
strings.str_hsim_us_mil_02_desc:
Operation Arrowhead is in effect. Combined U.S. and coalition forces are pushing their way into enemy territory.

As part of Task Force Knight, we have encountered heavy resistance in the mountains. Complex cave structures and mortar positions are slowing down our push north considerably.

You're tasked to provide fast-response Close Air Support (CAS) to these ground troops. Punch into enemy territory, maintain formation with your commander and engage marked targets.
strings.str_hsim_us_mil_02_briefing.html_8: You've managed to secure the crash site and the pilots are safe.
strings.str_hsim_us_mil_02_briefing.html_3: You did not assist in recovery of the crashed helicopter, but completed your mission.
strings.str_hsim_us_mil_02_briefing.html_1: You've failed to fly in formation with the lead helicopter.
strings.str_hsim_11_mil_outro_bro_0: Not at all, bro'. It's great to have you here helping out like this.
strings.str_hsim_11_mil_outro_bro_1: We've got a long way to go. But I know we can get there.
strings.str_hsim_11_mil_outro_pla_0: Wow, that's a real eye opener, Joey... I feel privileged that you can share your experiences with me.
strings.str_hsim_11_mil_outro_pla_1: That's more like the brother I know.
strings.str_hsim_10_rtb_mil_0: Whisky-6, Warmonger; R.T.B immediately, I say again, disengage and R.T.B.; out.
strings.str_hsim_09_ambient_thanks_bro_0: All part of the service. Real glad to have you aboard, man.
strings.str_hsim_09_ambient_thanks_cop_0: Damn, am I ever glad to see your ugly face.
strings.str_hsim_09_ambient_thanks_cop_1: No kidding, J-Dog; seriously, I owe you one.
strings.str_hsim_08b_task_expired_mil_0: Whisky-6, Warmonger; be advised: CSAR is incoming, stand down.
strings.str_hsim_08a_task_complete_bro_0: Warmonger, Whisky-6, understood; Renegade-1, Whisky-6, prep. for evac. - I'm coming in!
strings.str_hsim_08a_task_complete_mil_0: Whisky-6, Warmonger; enemy presence withdrawing the area. The crash site secure.
strings.str_hsim_08a_task_complete_mil_1: You are cleared to move in. Land and RTB with Captain Pierce.
strings.str_hsim_07_event_incoming_bro_0: Warmonger, Whisky-6, acknowledged; Renegade-1, Whisky-6, keep your head down!
strings.str_hsim_07_event_incoming_mil_0: Whisky-6, Warmonger, you have multiple targets moving in on your location; over.
strings.str_hsim_06_orders_bro_0: Warmonger, Whisky-6, understood; providing close air support; Whisky-6.
strings.str_hsim_06_orders_mil_0: Whisky-6, Warmonger, provide air cover for Renegade-1. Observe and support the crash-site; acknowledge.
strings.str_hsim_05_event_mayday_cop_0: Mayday, Mayday! This is Renegade-1 going down, I say again, Renegade-1 going down! Grid 01-07, acknowledge, over!
strings.str_hsim_05_event_mayday_mil_0: Warmonger to Renegade-1, copy that. Dispatching CSAR to your location, over.
strings.str_hsim_04_mil_start_bro_0: Renegade-1, Whisky-6; you know me man, I always like to make them wait! Ok, en route to your location; out.
strings.str_hsim_04_mil_start_cop_0: Whisky-6, Renegade-1; I'm holding at the rendezvous point; get your tail over here, a-sap; over.
strings.str_hsim_04_mil_start_cop_1: Whisky-6, Renegade-1; alright, you're doing just fine back there, J-Dog.
strings.str_hsim_04_mil_start_cop_2: Keep her tight now - nice and smooth - not too much altitude. Let's proceed.
strings.str_hsim_03_mil_intro_bro_0: The invasion had begun by this point, Operation Arrowhead was in effect.
strings.str_hsim_03_mil_intro_bro_1: We'd moved deeper into the North's territory, establishing Forward Operating Bases in the wake of a fast, coordinated attack.
strings.str_hsim_03_mil_intro_bro_2: We'd been assigned as support - part of a larger Air Weapons Team - providing tactical cover to ground forces forging their way north through the more dense settlements.
strings.str_hsim_02b_brother_later_bro_0: Oh, right, yeah. I'll just be, um, I'll catch up with you later, bro'.
strings.str_hsim_02b_brother_later_pla_1: Anyway, I better go grab a shower, I'm beat.
strings.str_hsim_02a_brother_continue_bro_0: Well... By this stage, the North had built up a significant fighting force; but, it was nothing unexpected.
strings.str_hsim_02a_brother_continue_bro_1: We're talking old soviet tanks, Cold War-era stuff, really. Dangerous, yes, but - well - nothing our Apache pilots couldn't handle.
strings.str_hsim_02a_brother_continue_pla_0: Oh, yeah? Why don't you tell me a little about it - it'd be, y'know, fascinating to hear, for sure.
strings.str_hsim_02a_brother_continue_bro_2: And didn't they just take pleasure in letting us know about it...
strings.str_hsim_01_core_outro_bro_0: Oh, y'know, Tom, just the usual.
strings.str_hsim_01_core_outro_bro_1: Yeah... whales, huh - who'd'a' thought it?
strings.str_hsim_01_core_outro_bro_2: Actually, it sort of reminded me of a flight back in South Asia.
strings.str_hsim_01_core_outro_pla_1: Sure, sure... Oh, it was an, uh, interesting flight... with the whales.
strings.str_hsim_01_core_outro_bro_3: Not.. Not the whales, obviously. The tracking - having to keep within a pattern, y'know?
strings.str_hsim_us_mil_01_sum: Operating out of CSL Archer, you're tasked to provide transport for your commanding officers, who are here to survey the strategic situation in the disputed region.
strings.str_hsim_us_mil_01_desc:
Operation Longbow is in effect. The U.S. Army has deployed to the region on training exercises; our goal is to get the men and vehicles properly acclimatised to the environment and familiar with the terrain.

To the north, an aggressive state is sabre-rattling: keen to claim the rich vein of oil deposits on this side of the border. Reports indicate that diplomatic routes are leading to dead ends, and we're getting close to a flashpoint. By now, it's no secret that we're conducting border patrols and making contact with the local population, with the full support of the fearful government here.

Today, we've got some top brass heading in to survey the situation. Operating out of CSL Archer, you're tasked to transport your commanding officer and a general above friendly territory.
strings.str_hsim_us_mil_01_briefing.html_7: You've flown the top brass to see the situation in the AO.
strings.str_hsim_us_mil_01_briefing.html_1: You did not fly as requested by the officers.
strings.str_hsim_one_liners_cop_0: Ok, J-dog, it's VIP transport today - let's make it a smooth ride.
strings.str_hsim_one_liners_cop_2: Easy, keep an eye on your gauges. Barometric pressure and wind.
strings.str_hsim_one_liners_cop_3: Things have a nasty habit of changing awful quick around here, J.
strings.str_hsim_one_liners_cop_4: Alright, Joe - that'll do - let's R.T.B.
strings.str_hsim_one_liners_cop_5: Careful, though, J-Dog, higher altitude means thinner air and, in turn, less lift. Pick our route carefully.
strings.str_hsim_one_liners_cop_6: Don't sweat it, man, the brass always get rattled by a little turbulence...
strings.str_hsim_one_liners_cop_7: J-Dog, there's some crazed local with a Goddamn AK down there. Take us out of range, a-sap.
strings.str_hsim_one_liners_cop_8: We don't want some farmer taking out a four-star Colonel, after all... now that's bad PR, man.
strings.str_hsim_10_mil_outro_bro_1: I - we - need to accept the situation. Try to move forwards together.
strings.str_hsim_10_mil_outro_pla_0: I'm sorry, Joe. I wish there was some way you get back up in the air.
strings.str_hsim_10_mil_outro_bro_2: Today was a sore one, Tom. A sore one.
strings.str_hsim_09_arrival_bro_1: Whisky-6, inbound to CSL Archer; requesting entry instructions; over.
strings.str_hsim_09_arrival_bro_2: Enter west, downwind, pad Bravo, Whisky-6.
strings.str_hsim_09_arrival_mil_0: Whisky-6, Papa Bear, pass your message.
strings.str_hsim_09_arrival_mil_1: Whisky-6, roger, enter west, downwind, pad Bravo; over.
strings.str_hsim_08_ambient_04_col_0: Excellent work. What's their current attitude - what's the feeling on the ground?
strings.str_hsim_08_ambient_04_com_0: This is the largest settlement in the immediate area.
strings.str_hsim_08_ambient_04_com_1: In conjunction with our local government contacts, we've held several meetings with tribal elders regarding our presence in the region.
strings.str_hsim_08_ambient_04_com_2: Somewhere between cautious and worried, sir. They dislike the increased military activity from their neighbours.
strings.str_hsim_08_ambient_04_com_3: We've reassured them that our presence could only benefit their security in the long-term.
strings.str_hsim_07_task_circle_com_0: Larkin! Take us up to a higher altitude; beat a path towards the nearest settlement, then RTB.
strings.str_hsim_06_ambient_03_col_0: And the local population, what kind of civilian activity is there in the area?
strings.str_hsim_06_ambient_03_col_1: Most of the action should be miles inwards from this border - we'll establish a presence in the heartland, working our way out.
strings.str_hsim_06_ambient_03_col_2: But it'll be important to secure this area; particularly, for the South - they're getting pretty fidgety about potential reprisals.
strings.str_hsim_06_ambient_03_com_0: Generally, they're clustered around the southern edge of the valley; isolated settlements dotted up the slopes.
strings.str_hsim_06_ambient_03_com_1: I'd say with confidence that it's largely goat tracks and the like to the north, leading up out of the valley toward the ridge.
strings.str_hsim_06_ambient_02_col_0: Understood. CAS will be made available when the time comes.
strings.str_hsim_06_ambient_02_com_0: See there, sir - that ridge in the north - that's pretty well dug-in.
strings.str_hsim_06_ambient_02_com_1: Sure, we can roll right past it, but, I'd say they've set up firing position for mortars.
strings.str_hsim_06_ambient_02_com_2: It's what I would do. Probably a whole truck-load of RPGs and the like.
strings.str_hsim_06_ambient_02_com_3: I know the men would be boosted by that, sir, they always get a kick from hearing the big guns in the air.
strings.str_hsim_06_ambient_01_col_0: How do you assess Operation Longbow's progress so far, Major?
strings.str_hsim_06_ambient_01_com_0: Admirably, sir. The men have been conducting patrols.
strings.str_hsim_06_ambient_01_com_1: We've had a chance to get acclimatised to the conditions, establish links with most of the local communities, and scout the terrain from the ground.
strings.str_hsim_05_mil_task_go_bro_0: Papa Bear, Whisky-6, acknowledged. Clear for take-off; heading north-east. Whisky-6.
strings.str_hsim_05_mil_task_go_mil_0: Whiskey-6, this is Papa Bear: you are cleared for takeoff. Exit north-east, over.
strings.str_hsim_05_mil_start_bro_0: We had some high-ranking officers and some media guys heading in to get an update on the situation.
strings.str_hsim_05_mil_start_bro_1: I was to fly out to the edge of the border, circle the routes our patrols used to make, while the brass were brought up to speed.
strings.str_hsim_04_mil_intro_bro_0: It was getting busier by the day - more and more activity in and around the CSL.
strings.str_hsim_04_mil_intro_bro_1: Chiefly, we were tasked with monitoring and supporting border patrols. This was pre-invasion, so the situation was largely safe.
strings.str_hsim_04_mil_intro_bro_2: Well, 'safe' as compared to what it became, at least.
strings.str_hsim_04_mil_intro_bro_3: The local population were cooperative. Still, the guys always complained that they looked at them with suspicion, or something.
strings.str_hsim_04_mil_intro_bro_4: You've gotta remember, this place was well used to conflict. Too used to it.
strings.str_hsim_04_mil_intro_bro_5: The border itself was just an idea - something drawn on a map - not in any way particularly 'defined', y'know, culturally.
strings.str_hsim_04_mil_intro_bro_6: From the air, you could pick out the scrapped tanks from back in the 80s pretty easily.
strings.str_hsim_04_mil_intro_bro_7: On the ground, the guys used to have to be wary of ancient land mines when heading off the beaten track.
strings.str_hsim_03b_brother_later_bro_0: Oh, sure. No - yeah - we'll catch up later bro'. Good flying today.
strings.str_hsim_03b_brother_later_pla_0: I've really gotta go dry off - this rain soaked me to my bones, Joey.
strings.str_hsim_03a_brother_continue_bro_0: It struck me today, Tom. I wasn't expecting it, y'know, but, it really struck me.
strings.str_hsim_03a_brother_continue_bro_1: I miss the flying. I really do miss it.
strings.str_hsim_03a_brother_continue_pla_0: I guess not, Joe. I've never wanted to pry.
strings.str_hsim_03a_brother_continue_pla_1: I respect your privacy - but, sure, I'd certainly be open to finding out a little more about your experience over there.
strings.str_hsim_03a_brother_continue_bro_2: Ah, come on now, Tombo! Don't kid yourself; you've got the same feel for these birds as I do - as dad did.
strings.str_hsim_03a_brother_continue_bro_3: Ok, well, it was the first real action we'd seen out there. You could tell things were just beginning to heat up a little...
strings.str_hsim_03a_brother_continue_pla_2: You were a great pilot, Joe - better than I could ever hope to be.
strings.str_hsim_02_brother_bro_0: That's good. Good news - a fair price. Um, how, uh, how did you find the flight?
strings.str_hsim_02_brother_bro_1: No - I mean - yea, nothing like it. It reminded me of operations back in South Asia.
strings.str_hsim_02_brother_pla_0: So, that's the deal done. The buyer accepted the price you'd both agreed upon.
strings.str_hsim_02_brother_bro_2: I've never really talked about the campaign with you, have I?
strings.str_hsim_02_brother_pla_1: Sure, yeah, fine. There's nothing like a little VIP transport, Joe.
strings.str_hsim_02_brother_pla_2: Sure, sure.. heck, I can only imagine.
strings.str_hsim_us_core_p2_02_sum:
Safely deliver heavy-weight materials to the Veteran's Memorial Parade-ground.

Regards,
M.C.
strings.str_hsim_us_core_p2_02_im_9: J:no, no, it's ok man! no, I know that feeling all too well! its a rush
strings.str_hsim_us_core_p2_02_im_8: T:It's just... It's like I'm still pumped from the flight or something...
strings.str_hsim_us_core_p2_02_im_7: T:I wish you could be, man. Honestly, I really do.
strings.str_hsim_us_core_p2_02_im_6: T:Sorry, I sure don't mean to be insensitive, Joe.
strings.str_hsim_us_core_p2_02_im_5: J:I know -- I just wish I could be up in the air too
strings.str_hsim_us_core_p2_02_im_4: T:And, honestly - if this warm-up was anything to go by - flying for the veterans show proper is gonna to be such a blast!
strings.str_hsim_us_core_p2_02_im_22: T:But, no, you're right. Seriously. We'll get through this - take on any problems we have side by side, Joe.
strings.str_hsim_us_core_p2_02_im_20: T:Hah, sorry. God, I can't help myself - I'm such an ass!
strings.str_hsim_us_core_p2_02_im_2: T:Ok, I'm back! Reeeeally needed a shower (apparently I get nervous when I try tunt flying)!
strings.str_hsim_us_core_p2_02_im_18: J:but, as long as your hear, bro -- at least right now -- that's all that matters
strings.str_hsim_us_core_p2_02_im_17: J:yeah. I guess there's no hiding that
strings.str_hsim_us_core_p2_02_im_16: T:Maybe... changing in a way that you don't always agree with.
strings.str_hsim_us_core_p2_02_im_15: T:Nothing, nothing, just... I know things have been changing around here.
strings.str_hsim_us_core_p2_02_im_13: T:You're right - that's more like the brother I know.
strings.str_hsim_us_core_p2_02_im_12: J:yeah, but, what can we do except, yknow, try to move forward?
strings.str_hsim_us_core_p2_02_im_11: T:Thanks, bro. I know it's tough for you at the moment.
strings.str_hsim_us_core_p2_02_im_10: J:I'm just real glad you can experience the things dad and I have enjoyed for so many years
strings.str_hsim_us_core_p2_02_im_1: -:Your status is now set to Online
strings.str_hsim_us_core_p2_02_desc:
CIVIL AVIATION CONTRACT
Vrana Industries Incorporated, hereafter referred to as the COMPANY, and the CONTRACTOR hereby agree to enter into a new formal arrangement hereafter referred to as the CONTRACT.

The COMPANY requires the CONTRACTOR to supply materials, care of Lt. Col. Sam Nichols, USA, Ret., hereafter referred to as the CLIENT, to the Bremerton Docklands.

The CONTRACTOR will coordinate with CLIENT ground staff, and ensure the safe and prompt delivery of heavy-weight materials. Damage caused to cargo materials will result in the termination of the CONTRACT.
strings.str_hsim_us_core_p2_02_briefing.html_6: You've prepared for participation in the memorial air show.
strings.str_hsim_us_core_p2_02_aerobatics_diary1: Backwards flight: fly a short while backwards (%1 seconds). You need to fly with a negative speed of %2 or more and cannot deviate your initial heading much.
strings.str_hsim_us_core_p2_02_aerobatics_diary2: Fast 180 turn: perform a quick 180 degree turn to the left or right. You need to be going over %1 first, and you have %2 seconds to complete the turn.
strings.str_hsim_ambient_job_done_vtb_0: Same goes for me, son, it takes me way back!
strings.str_hsim_ambient_job_done_vtc_0: Great flying today, Tom! It was sure something - stirred up a lotta old memories... memories, maybe I didn't even know I had.
strings.str_hsim_ambient_memories_2_vtb_0: But I gotta say, it feels good not seeing incoming fire this time around!
strings.str_hsim_ambient_memories_2_vtc_0: That 'pwup', 'pwup', 'pwup', it's... it's like it's a part of you; it's engrained.
strings.str_hsim_task_simple_vta_0: Ok, Tom, first off, maybe try some simple moves...
strings.str_hsim_task_simple_vta_1: Y'know, backwards flight, fast 180 turns, that kinda thing!
strings.str_hsim_task_formation_vta_0: Ok, Tom. We'll start with a bit of formation flight.
strings.str_hsim_task_formation_vta_1: Take us up and just try to keep aligned with the lead bird.
strings.str_hsim_task_finished_vta_0: Alright, Tom! Fine flying - you'd make your father proud!
strings.str_hsim_task_finished_vta_1: That'll be enough for today, though, set her down back at the pad and we'll drop these guys off.
strings.str_hsim_task_complex_vta_0: Alright then, now let's go a little further...
strings.str_hsim_task_complex_vta_1: How about... strafing flight, oh, or a bow to the crowd? That's always popular!
strings.str_hsim_one_liners_start_vta_0: Ahah! A little reverse-flight, is it?
strings.str_hsim_one_liners_start_vta_1: Yeah, strafing's always a classic move.
strings.str_hsim_one_liners_start_vta_2: A 360? You're a natural-born crowd-pleaser, Tom!
strings.str_hsim_one_liners_prompts_vta_0: How about a little backwards flying?
strings.str_hsim_one_liners_prompts_vta_2: You could try getting into a hover and spinning us around?
strings.str_hsim_one_liners_prompts_vta_3: Do you know how to do a bow?
strings.str_hsim_one_liners_prompts_vta_4: A few hard turns wouldn't go amiss!
strings.str_hsim_one_liners_prompts_vta_5: How about something a little more advanced?
strings.str_hsim_one_liners_positivity_vta_2: Very nice, son! Harry would be real proud!
strings.str_hsim_one_liners_end_vta_0: Great move, flying backwards is always a crowd-pleaser.
strings.str_hsim_one_liners_end_vta_1: Nice, that was nice. Great strafing.
strings.str_hsim_one_liners_end_vta_4: That's it, son, you've nailed it!
strings.str_hsim_one_liners_end_vta_5: Hah! Well done, looks like you're getting the hang of it now, son!
strings.str_hsim_feedback_formation_pla_0: Uh, whatever you say, Nichols! What exactly did you have in mind?
strings.str_hsim_feedback_formation_vta_1: Now - how about we try something a little more advanced?
strings.str_hsim_feedback_formation_vta_2: Part of the show features our pilots doing a little show-boating...
strings.str_hsim_feedback_formation_vta_3: Strafing, backwards flight, bowing, 360-hover-turns... what'd'ya say we give a few of those a spin, Tom?
strings.str_hsim_event_startup_man_0: Well hello, Tom! You may be pleased to know that it's a simple enough contract today - transporting cargo.
strings.str_hsim_event_startup_man_1: And Tom, just remember: take a little extra care with the added weight of the cargo, ok?
strings.str_hsim_event_startup_man_2: Just looking after my assets, Tom! Have a safe flight.
strings.str_hsim_event_startup_pla_0: Yeah, I'm glad to hear it, Ms Carmichael.
strings.str_hsim_event_startup_pla_1: Sure. Hey, thanks for the heads up, Michelle.
strings.str_hsim_event_radio_new_0: So, those heading down to the Veterans Parade this weekend should be in for a fine day, but - as always - it's best advised to pack a waterproof or two in Rain City...
strings.str_hsim_event_radio_new_1: For now, that's it from me, Don Kinsley; here's George with a round-up of all the latest sports news...
strings.str_hsim_event_meeting_pla_0: Well, it's quite a set up you have here, sir!
strings.str_hsim_event_meeting_pla_1: Sure, Nichols. So... you knew dad?
strings.str_hsim_event_meeting_vta_0: Check out that big screen, huh? They're right, what they say, Tom, the camera does add ten pounds!
strings.str_hsim_event_meeting_pla_2: Y'know... that's not the first time a buddy of his has told me that!
strings.str_hsim_event_meeting_vta_1: Please, please, it's Nichols - your father wouldn't have it any other way, and neither will I.
strings.str_hsim_event_meeting_pla_3: Right, right, yeah... Dad never really talked much about his time in the military.
strings.str_hsim_event_meeting_vta_2: Tom, I knew more of your father than I care to remember, heh!
strings.str_hsim_event_meeting_vta_3: Well, that was old 'Dirty Harry' for ya! Yeah, we saw some action together back in, ah... '85!
strings.str_hsim_event_meeting_vta_4: Ah, that's Harry, though - I tell ya, he'd'a loved an event like this, though...
strings.str_hsim_event_landed_pla_0: Thanks, Nichols... and, thanks for the opportunity, too.
strings.str_hsim_event_landed_pla_1: Me too, see you this weekend!
strings.str_hsim_event_landed_vta_0: Alright, Tom! Thanks for helping us out at such short notice. Once again, great flying.
strings.str_hsim_event_landed_vta_1: Not at all; it's me that appreciates your help. I look forward to flying with ya on the big day itself, Tom.
strings.str_hsim_event_help_pla_0: Well, sure, I guess... what exactly would it involve, though?
strings.str_hsim_event_help_pla_1: That sounds great but, y'know, I, er...
strings.str_hsim_event_help_vta_0: Hey... I'll tell ya what - we're one pilot short - what'd'ya think of lending a hand?
strings.str_hsim_event_help_pla_2: Well, yeah, what the heck, let's do it, then!
strings.str_hsim_event_help_vta_1: We're due to take up some vets and media guys; idea is that they talk about their experiences while we fly in formation.
strings.str_hsim_event_help_vta_2: Hell, Tom, this is just a dry-run! The event itself takes place in a few days time. Plenty of time to practise. Wha'd'ya say?
strings.str_hsim_event_help_vta_3: Your bird is the one on the end, Tom. Go ahead, jump in!
strings.str_hsim_event_approach_pla_0_0: Lima Alpha Seven Zero; Requesting permission to land; over.
strings.str_hsim_event_approach_pla_1: Confirmed. This is the Vrana Industries transport operating under Larkin Aviation. We've got a heavy load for the show incoming; over.
strings.str_hsim_event_approach_pla_2: No, it's actually Tom Larkin here; I'm Joe's younger brother...
strings.str_hsim_event_approach_vta_0: Uh, acknowledged, Lima Alpha Seven Zero. This is the... Vrana Corp delivery? Over.
strings.str_hsim_event_approach_vta_1: Larkin? Hey, is this Harry's boy? Joe, is that you..?
strings.str_hsim_event_approach_vta_2: Well, I'll be..! The name's Nichols, hah... I'm an old friend of your father!
strings.str_hsim_event_approach_vta_3: Set the bird down on any empty pad - the boys will unload the chopper.
strings.str_hsim_event_approach_vta_4: And, uh, after you land, be sure to head across here! Out.
strings.str_hsim_ambient_returning_bro_0: Hi, Tom, it's your brother here - is everything ok? I've been trying to reach you for a while now.
strings.str_hsim_ambient_returning_bro_1: Oh, thank goodness. Oh, I know Sam; great Guy - old friend of dad's - glad you could meet him!
strings.str_hsim_ambient_returning_bro_2: Awesome news. Alright, drop by when you get back... I need to lie down for a while. My back is playing up again.
strings.str_hsim_ambient_returning_pla_0: Joe! Hi, no, don't worry! I've been helping Sam Nichols out, he's running the show here...
strings.str_hsim_ambient_returning_pla_1: Not only that, but he's roped me in to helping out on the parade this weekend. It should be great!
strings.str_hsim_ambient_memories_1_vtb_0: Just flying in this aircraft... y'know, it brings back a lot of memories - good and bad.
strings.str_hsim_ambient_memories_1_vtc_0: We rode to war in this thing, Tom.
strings.str_hsim_ambient_memories_1_vtc_1: We did what we thought was right - we did what we had to - for our country.
strings.str_hsim_ambient_memories_03_pla_0: Sure, I can understand why dad was - why you are - so closely involved with this setup.
strings.str_hsim_ambient_memories_03_vta_0: These guys had no 'welcome home'... The vets, the families, those lost; it's chance for everyone to say hello, or, y'know, say goodbye.
strings.str_hsim_ambient_memories_03_vta_1: Your dad made this a part of his life. Honestly, it warms my heart to see you becoming a part of it too, Tom.
strings.str_hsim_ambient_introductions_pla_0: Thanks, it's an honour to fly with you all.
strings.str_hsim_ambient_introductions_vta_0: Tom, say hello to retired Chief Warrant Officer Bill Novak and lieutenant Colonel Mike Buchanan. Both of these boys knew your father, of course.
strings.str_hsim_ambient_introductions_vtb_0: Pleasure to meet you, son. Harry was a good man.
strings.str_hsim_ambient_introductions_vtc_0: Tom is it? Harry always spoke affectionately about his boys. He'd be proud to see you up in this old bird, I can tell you!
strings.str_hsim_ambient_briefing_bro_0: So, Tom, this veteran's parade - it all kicks off in a few days time - Vrana's contracted us to fly out some last-minute equipment to them via us.
strings.str_hsim_ambient_briefing_bro_1: Oh, yeah, he had a lot of old buddies there; practically ran their logistics - all at cost, too.
strings.str_hsim_ambient_briefing_bro_2: Exactly, something Vrana Corp'd never do!
strings.str_hsim_ambient_briefing_pla_0: Ok, sure... yeah - hey - dad used to be pretty heavily involved in that, huh?
strings.str_hsim_ambient_briefing_bro_3: Not like I've seen the details of this contract - that's all handled by Michelle now, of course...
strings.str_hsim_ambient_briefing_bro_4: Anyway, they're actually busy loading up the chopper now. The guys at the show need it a-sap and there's an agreement in place guaranteeing delivery this afternoon...
strings.str_hsim_ambient_briefing_bro_5: ...and, honestly - after the circus-acts they had you flying last time, Tom - at least it's a nice simple job.
strings.str_hsim_us_core_p2_02_aerobatics_diary3: Bow to the crowds: maintain a stable hover and dip your nose to the crowd three times without moving off your spot. Your total velocity may not be over %1. Also make sure not to change your heading too much.
strings.str_hsim_us_core_p2_02_aerobatics_diary4: 360 degree hover turn: maintain a stable hover and turn a full 360 degrees. Do not stop turning and keep your total velocity under %1.
strings.str_hsim_us_core_p2_02_aerobatics_diary5: Strafe: fly sideways left or right for a short while (%1 seconds) while not moving forward or backward (over %2).
strings.str_hsim_us_core_p2_02_aerobatics_hint: Notes about aerobatic maneuvers you may perform have been added to your diary.
strings.str_hsim_us_core_p2_01_sum:
Rendezvous with the CLIENT; support the CLIENT with on-demand training exercises.

Regards,
M.C.
strings.str_hsim_us_core_p2_01_im_9: -:'Work - Joe' added Michelle_Carmichael81 to the conversation
strings.str_hsim_us_core_p2_01_im_8: T:Keep a cool head - we'll get through this!
strings.str_hsim_us_core_p2_01_im_7: T:Look, Joey, don't blame yourself, man.
strings.str_hsim_us_core_p2_01_im_6: J:and Im angry at myself for letting you get roped into this sham
strings.str_hsim_us_core_p2_01_im_5: J:Im so goddamn angry with carmichael.
strings.str_hsim_us_core_p2_01_im_4: J:now look at this -- its a joke Tom. nothing more
strings.str_hsim_us_core_p2_01_im_3: J:no. I told you that your safety was my NUMBER ONE concern
strings.str_hsim_us_core_p2_01_im_2: T:It's ok, man, everything worked out fine in the end.
strings.str_hsim_us_core_p2_01_im_19: M:That's simply the reality of the situation, boys - but - I will personally speak to Mr Haydon
strings.str_hsim_us_core_p2_01_im_18: M:But the fact remains that Vrana Corp acted within the constraints of the contract, and cannot be seen to concede any formal liability
strings.str_hsim_us_core_p2_01_im_16: M:and I do sincerely wish that things had worked out a little differently
strings.str_hsim_us_core_p2_01_im_15: M:I'm afraid it is, Joe. It is quite the point. Look, I can offer my personal apology
strings.str_hsim_us_core_p2_01_im_13: M:But, it is important to note that it was nothing outside of the bounds of our formal agreements
strings.str_hsim_us_core_p2_01_im_12: M:Look, about today, I am sorry that you feel our client placed Tom in an unacceptable situation
strings.str_hsim_us_core_p2_01_im_10: J:carmichael, I think you owe my brother an apology
strings.str_hsim_us_core_p2_01_im_1: J:what did I tell you, bro? goddamn cowboys - the lot of em
strings.str_hsim_us_core_p2_01_desc:
CIVIL AVIATION CONTRACT
Vrana Industries Incorporated, hereafter referred to as the COMPANY, and the CONTRACTOR hereby agree to enter into a new formal arrangement hereafter referred to as the CONTRACT.

The COMPANY requires the CONTRACTOR to supply collateral training support for ION Incorporated, at the Northwest Training Centre, under the authority of Brian Frost, hereafter referred to as the CLIENT.

The CONTRACTOR will assist in standard training manoeuvres, providing a range of support alongside training exercises, under the supervision and direction of the CLIENT. Failure to comply with training support protocols will result in the termination of the CONTRACT.
strings.str_hsim_us_core_p2_01_briefing.html_1: You did not fly according to ION's wishes.
strings.str_hsim_feedback_quicklanding_1_good_pm: Alright! You even managed not to kill us all!
That's it! A quick in and out!
strings.str_hsim_feedback_quicklanding_1_bad_pmc: We don't have all day, Larking!
You'd really call that a fast landing?
strings.str_hsim_task_refuel_bro_0: Alright, ok, I've updated your data with the closest heliport.
strings.str_hsim_task_refuel_bro_1: You're low on fuel, so make a quick decision about the fastest approach.
strings.str_hsim_task_refuel_bro_2: It's up to you which way is best - I can't really judge it from here.
strings.str_hsim_task_quicklanding_2_pmc_0: Alright then. Now I want a fast extraction.
strings.str_hsim_task_quicklanding_2_pmc_1: Land quickly, get the boys aboard, and get the hell out of there!
strings.str_hsim_task_quicklanding_1_pmc_0: Alright then. I want a fast insertion.
strings.str_hsim_task_quicklanding_1_pmc_1: Larking will set us down. Lads, quick dismount on my orders. Weapons free down range.
strings.str_hsim_task_lowlevel_pmc_0: Ok, take us down. The boys've gotta get used to low-level flight in rapid deployment situations.
strings.str_hsim_task_lowlevel_pmc_1: I want to be able to touch the Goddamn trees, Larking.
strings.str_hsim_task_lowlevel_pmc_2: Keep our altitude below the specified flight-ceiling, d'you copy that?
strings.str_hsim_task_land_pmc_1: Set us down over there by the range, Larking.
strings.str_hsim_task_land_pmc_2: Clearly, my lads could still do with some extra practise!
strings.str_hsim_task_horseplay_pla_0: Uh, actually, I'm not sure if that's really part of...
strings.str_hsim_task_horseplay_pmc_0: Hey, here's something... That's my buddy Asano down there.
strings.str_hsim_task_horseplay_pmc_1: Shift the chopper over and give him a blast of the rotor-wash!
strings.str_hsim_task_horseplay_pmc_2: Move it, Larking! That little arsehole had the very same happen to me on my deployment! Quickly!
strings.str_hsim_task_handling_pla_0: Sure, she's a real pleasure to fly.
strings.str_hsim_task_handling_pla_1: Oh, I'll see what I can do...
strings.str_hsim_task_handling_sam_0: Hey, this is some chopper, though.
strings.str_hsim_task_handling_sam_1: Any chance that you can put her through her paces? Y'know, show me what she's capable of?
strings.str_hsim_one_liners_sam_feedback_sam_2: Oh, it is really something, alright!
strings.str_hsim_one_liners_pmc_feedback_pmc_1: What did I say about touching the trees, Larking?
strings.str_hsim_one_liners_pmc_feedback_pmc_2: Get us back under the flight ceiling, now.
strings.str_hsim_one_liners_pmc_feedback_pmc_5: Get us back up to speed, man.
strings.str_hsim_one_liners_pmc_feedback_pmc_8: What exactly is the problem, here?
strings.str_hsim_one_liners_commands_pmc_4: Follow the course of the valley!
strings.str_hsim_one_liners_commands_pmc_5: Track along the path of the road!
strings.str_hsim_feedback_lowlevel_good_pmc_0: Alright, that's enough, Larking. Not Bad.
strings.str_hsim_feedback_lowlevel_good_pmc_1: Beat a path over to the firing range, sharpish.
strings.str_hsim_feedback_lowlevel_bad_pmc_0: Alright, we're done here. Anymore and you'd crash anyway.
strings.str_hsim_feedback_lowlevel_bad_pmc_1: Beat a path over to the firing range. And try not to kill us, huh?
strings.str_hsim_feedback_horseplay_pmc_1: Maybe you're not completely useless after all, Larking!
strings.str_hsim_event_refuelling_pla_0: Look, I'm real sorry about this whole unannounced landing - it was, uh, something of an emergency...
strings.str_hsim_event_refuelling_pla_1: Sure, she handles like a beauty - when she's got fuel, at least.
strings.str_hsim_event_refuelling_pla_2: Something like that. The name's Tom, by the way, Tom Larkin, I work up at Highland Park.
strings.str_hsim_event_refuelling_sam_0: Ah, don't sweat it... hey, that's a fine chopper you've got there, though - a real whirlwind, huh?
strings.str_hsim_event_refuelling_pla_3: Uh, sure, yeah. It'd be my pleasure. We'll invoice our business manager for the fuel once we arrive.
strings.str_hsim_event_refuelling_sam_1: Oh... yeah, I see you've found yourself in a bit of a pickle!
strings.str_hsim_event_refuelling_sam_2: Oh, yes, Larkin Aviation. I was sorry to hear the news about your father, Tom. A real fine gentleman.
strings.str_hsim_event_refuelling_sam_3: Look now, I'd be willing to refuel your bird, Tom... In return, I'd just love to get up in the air and see how she handles!
strings.str_hsim_event_refuelling_sam_4: You think you can give me a ride up to Highland Park? Heck, I've got some business to attend to in Downtown anyway.
strings.str_hsim_event_radio_intro_new_0_0: ...send in any snaps of the warships in the harbour, we'll try to get those up on our website, KBBC-radio.com!
strings.str_hsim_event_radio_intro_new_1_0: And, on-topic, we gotta great piece coming up with Sam Nichols, the event organiser and US Army veteran himself; but first, let's grab the weather and travel with Tracy.
strings.str_hsim_event_radio_intro_new_2_0: ... Tracy! So, just when exactly is it gonna rain today?
strings.str_hsim_event_pmc_pla_1: Yeah, just one - uh, sir - I seem to be missing the flight plan..?
strings.str_hsim_event_pmc_pmc_0: You must be Larking. The name's Frost, I'm the training super. Today, I'm your boss. We'll brief and then get airborne.
strings.str_hsim_event_pmc_pmc_1: Alright, listen up! We got two exercises to get through today.
strings.str_hsim_event_pmc_pmc_2: First up: low-level flight - getting the boys used to quick insertions and evacs.
strings.str_hsim_event_pmc_pmc_3: Secondary objective: live-fire exercises at the range. Questions?
strings.str_hsim_event_pmc_pmc_4: There is no fixed route, Larking. You'll be responding directly to my commands. When I say bank right, you sure as hell bank right. Roger that?
strings.str_hsim_event_pmc_pmc_5: Good. Ok, boys, board the chopper!
strings.str_hsim_event_pmc_pmc_6: Right, Larking, get the bird in the air. Fine day for flying.
strings.str_hsim_event_landing_pla_0_0: Ok, here we are. Thanks so much for your help today.
strings.str_hsim_event_landing_pla_1: She sure is, ok, we'll settle up the fuel bill as soon as possible - you'll be able to send us an invoice?
strings.str_hsim_event_landing_sam_0: Oh, not at all, that was just great; what a great ride.
strings.str_hsim_event_landing_sam_1: Yeah, no problem - I'll just, uh, go on ahead and make it out to Vrana Corp!
strings.str_hsim_event_landed_2_pmc_1: Move it, lads! You're under fire!
strings.str_hsim_event_landed_2_pmc_2: Larking - once they're aboard - take us up, sharpish!
strings.str_hsim_event_landed_1_pmc_1: Larking, back up in the air, man!
strings.str_hsim_event_landed_1_pmc_2: Rapid bursts! Lay down some cover, Goddamnit!
strings.str_hsim_event_handling_done_pla_0: Sure - I guess there had to be some!
strings.str_hsim_event_handling_done_sam_0: Oh, wow: it's so responsive. What a bird, huh?
strings.str_hsim_event_handling_done_sam_1: I guess there are advantages working with the big boys!
strings.str_hsim_event_bingo_bro_0: Absolutely - is everything ok, Tommy? What's the matter?
strings.str_hsim_event_bingo_bro_1: What the heck? Off-the-books manoeuvres? Y'know, that isn't part of our contract, Tom.
strings.str_hsim_event_bingo_pla_1: Hey, bro', it's Tom. Can you get me some quick info..?
strings.str_hsim_event_bingo_bro_2: Goddamned cowboys... ok, just sit tight - I'll get right back to you, bro'.
strings.str_hsim_event_bingo_pla_2: I'm fine - everything's fine - except, well, the flight plan. Seems it was a bit, uh, off; they hadn't factored in all of the manoeuvres...
strings.str_hsim_event_bingo_pla_3: I know, I know - point is: fuel is going to be a problem. I need you to find me somewhere that I can land and take on extra.
strings.str_hsim_ambient_warm_welcome_bro_0: Just what on earth did you have my brother doing out there?
strings.str_hsim_ambient_warm_welcome_bro_1: - well, that's an understatement, Ms. Carmichael -
strings.str_hsim_ambient_warm_welcome_bro_2: When we controlled this business, it wasn't just about what was 'right' - it was about doing what was proper.
strings.str_hsim_ambient_warm_welcome_man_0: Yes, it may not be to your taste, Mr. Larkin, but...
strings.str_hsim_ambient_warm_welcome_bro_3: What did I say? Just Goddammed cowboys.
strings.str_hsim_ambient_warm_welcome_man_1: ...the fact remains that Vrana Corp acted well within its rights - both legally and contractually.
strings.str_hsim_ambient_warm_welcome_man_2: Look - for what it's worth - I am sorry that you feel your brother was put at risk, but, he's a very capable pilot, and you should remember that.
strings.str_hsim_ambient_warm_welcome_man_3: Good day to you, Mr Larkin.
strings.str_hsim_ambient_uncomfortable_3_pla_0: That's true, and we very much intend to keep it that way.
strings.str_hsim_ambient_uncomfortable_3_sam_0: Just a word of warning though, I've seen strong family businesses disappear under the weight of corporate ownership.
strings.str_hsim_ambient_uncomfortable_3_sam_1: ...and the Larkins have been part of the fabric of civil aviation here for years.
strings.str_hsim_ambient_uncomfortable_2_pla_0: Well, we still retain our independence. It's, uh, more of a partnership, really.
strings.str_hsim_ambient_uncomfortable_2_sam_0: So... word is, Larkin Aviation's in bed with Vrana Corp now... Tricky business, Tom, tricky business!
strings.str_hsim_ambient_uncomfortable_2_sam_1: Oh, I'm sure, I'm sure. Though, I know your father resisted take-overs from the bigger companies for years...
strings.str_hsim_ambient_uncomfortable_2_sam_2: But... yeah, times are tough - I don't mean to make any judgement there, Tom - simply... a friendly observation.
strings.str_hsim_ambient_uncomfortable_1_pla_0: Pleasure to meet you, Ms Townsend. Thanks again for the help.
strings.str_hsim_ambient_uncomfortable_1_sam_0: I'm awful sorry, in my excitement I've forgotten to introduce myself. It's Maggie Townsend, nice to meet you, Tom Larkin!
strings.str_hsim_ambient_uncomfortable_1_sam_1: Oh, I will not hear another word about it, Tom!
strings.str_hsim_ambient_sorry_bro_0: Hey, Tom, sorry if... y'know, if I was a bit short with you before.
strings.str_hsim_ambient_sorry_bro_1: I know. It's just, these contractors - the very same - they were getting deployed to South Asia just as I was finishing up my last tour over there.
strings.str_hsim_ambient_sorry_bro_2: They - those like them... y'know, they don't have a good rep. Just guns for hire.
strings.str_hsim_ambient_sorry_pla_0: No problem, really. Hey, I didn't mean to come across, y'know, flippant or whatever...
strings.str_hsim_ambient_sorry_pla_1: Sure, man, I understand. I'll watch myself, and... thanks, Joe, I know you're just looking out for me.
strings.str_hsim_ambient_anger_bro_0: Oh, y'know, not much... you're tasked to fly down to some facility; assist with the training of PMCs for 'ION' - some subsidiary of Vrana Corp.
strings.str_hsim_ambient_anger_bro_1: Honestly, I'd watch myself. These guys are cowboys - contractors always are - no respect, y'know? No... class.
strings.str_hsim_ambient_anger_bro_2: Right, right, because you're the expert. Anyway, I'm a little busy so, look, I'll catch up with you later.
strings.str_hsim_ambient_anger_pla_1: It'll be fine, Joe, don't sweat it.
strings.str_hsim_ambient_anger_pla_2: Sure, uh, yeah... take it easy, man. See you later.
strings.str_hsim_us_core_p1_05_sum:
Pick up the CLIENT from the specified location. Ensure prompt delivery of the CLIENT to the final destination.
M.C.
strings.str_hsim_us_core_p1_05_im_9: M:And also for the added delay caused by the delivery of extra equipment
strings.str_hsim_us_core_p1_05_im_8: -:Your status is now set to Busy
strings.str_hsim_us_core_p1_05_im_7: M:I do apologise if it wasn't clear that this arrangement had been authorised by Mr Haydon
strings.str_hsim_us_core_p1_05_im_6: M:I feel that perhaps we didn't get off to the best of starts...
strings.str_hsim_us_core_p1_05_im_4: M:Thank you for the escort to Highland Park %1
strings.str_hsim_us_core_p1_05_im_22: M:I really do hope to have a good working relationship with the Larkin brothers! %1
strings.str_hsim_us_core_p1_05_im_21: M:Anyway, I just thought I should get that out the way
strings.str_hsim_us_core_p1_05_im_20: -:Your status is now set to Away
strings.str_hsim_us_core_p1_05_im_19: M:Really, I'm just here to make ensure that adjustment is as easy as possible for all
strings.str_hsim_task_ships_bro_0: Basically, there's extra flight restrictions in place.
strings.str_hsim_task_ships_bro_1: You'll need to either divert around them or gain enough height to pass above safely.
strings.str_hsim_one_liners_ambient_man_0: Um, yes? Can I help you, Tom?
strings.str_hsim_one_liners_ambient_man_1: Hi, Penny, yes I'm safe and sound. Yeah... yeah I know, right? No, it wasn't professional conduct.
strings.str_hsim_one_liners_ambient_man_2: Yeah, no, you're right. Totally. Ok. I'll email across those details, by the way. I'll set up and - yup, yup - sure, sure. Ok, bye for now!
strings.str_hsim_event_ships_bro_0: Tom - sorry to bother you again - look, there's another detail I should have told you...
strings.str_hsim_event_ships_bro_1: So, there are some ships - military vessels - moving through Puget Sound.
strings.str_hsim_event_ships_bro_2: They're part of an upcoming Veteran's Parade. I'm sorry, it totally slipped my mind.
strings.str_hsim_event_ships_pla_0: It's ok, Joe, no problem. Go ahead.
strings.str_hsim_event_pickup_ceo_0: Greetings, Mr Larkin. How does the day find you?
strings.str_hsim_event_pickup_ceo_1: Yes, and I'm aware you're a little late.
strings.str_hsim_event_pickup_ceo_2: Please, take me directly to the airfield.
strings.str_hsim_event_pickup_pla_0: Very well, Mr Haydon, thanks... I'm aware that you're in something of a rush?
strings.str_hsim_event_dropoff_ceo_0: Oh - yes - Mr. Larkin. You are to transport my business associate back to Highland Park Heliport.
strings.str_hsim_event_dropoff_ceo_1: She will explain the details en route.
strings.str_hsim_event_dropoff_ceo_2: Yes, details, Mr Larkin - those little things that endow facts with reason.
strings.str_hsim_event_cleared_bro_0: Ok, Tom, you should be all clear now.
strings.str_hsim_event_cleared_bro_1: Sorry about the wait - these boys caught me a little off-guard.
strings.str_hsim_event_cleared_bro_2: I'm aware who she is - we'll discuss that in private, Tom.
strings.str_hsim_event_cleared_pla_0: Sure, Joe. That's fine. Uh, also, I have a Ms Carmichael with me. She's supposed to be -
strings.str_hsim_event_circling_man_0: I'm sorry Tom, part of our take over I'm afraid. New equipment.
strings.str_hsim_event_circling_man_1: Just circle around until a pad frees up; it shouldn't be too long now.
strings.str_hsim_event_circling_pla_0: Ah, seems we have a problem - it's too busy to land down there...
strings.str_hsim_event_boarded_man_0: It's a pleasure to meet you, Mr Larkin!
strings.str_hsim_event_boarded_man_1: My name's Michelle Carmichael, but, please, call me Michelle.
strings.str_hsim_event_boarded_pla_0: Sure. It's Tom, by the way, Tom Larkin.
strings.str_hsim_ambient_rushed_bro_1: I just got a call about getting a flight out over to Vrana HQ. That CEO has a plane to catch... like, now.
strings.str_hsim_ambient_rushed_pla_0: What's up, bro'? Anything the matter..?
strings.str_hsim_ambient_rushed_pla_1: Ok, no problem. I'll head out myself.
strings.str_hsim_ambient_ride_back_man_0: Sorry, what's that Tom? I only caught the end of what you were saying.
strings.str_hsim_ambient_ride_back_man_1: Oh, I see... I've been appointed as your new business manager, Tom - on location.
strings.str_hsim_ambient_ride_back_pla_0: So, um, I'm instructed to take you to our heliport - have you, uh, pre-arranged further transport..?
strings.str_hsim_ambient_ride_back_pla_1: ...or will, I mean, I can have my brother drive you..?
strings.str_hsim_ambient_ride_back_man_2: That's correct. I'll be overseeing operations from Highland Park - providing support for both you and your brother.
strings.str_hsim_ambient_ride_back_pla_2: Sure, sure. Yeah, I was wondering what your arrangements were? The, uh, 'details'.
strings.str_hsim_ambient_ride_back_pla_3: To - wait, what - our business manager?
strings.str_hsim_ambient_guilt_bro_0: Look, Tom, sorry about the rush here. Y'know, it's... it's not the way I like to work.
strings.str_hsim_ambient_guilt_bro_1: And, to be honest, they sent over the details late last night but - I dunno - somehow it slipped my mind.
strings.str_hsim_ambient_guilt_bro_2: Ok, well, that's the thing - there's not a lot of time - get out there as quickly as possible; but, Tom, take it steady.
strings.str_hsim_ambient_guilt_pla_0: Don't worry about, Joe. I'll get over there right away.
strings.str_hsim_ambient_circling_man_0: Perks of the agreement... I'm not the only thing you boys get as part of the take-over, Mr Larkin.
strings.str_hsim_ambient_circling_man_1: We just needed to upgrade some of your equipment. Partly for sharing maintenance costs; partly to standardise your operational capacity.
strings.str_hsim_ambient_circling_pla_0: What is all this activity, Ms Carmichael?
strings.str_hsim_ambient_circling_man_2: We're simply... bringing you into line with Vrana Corp's requirements.
strings.str_hsim_ambient_advantages_ceo_0: The advantages of our corporation, Mr Larkin.
strings.str_hsim_ambient_advantages_ceo_1: This little airfield - our destination - is part-operated by 'ION', which forms the central arm of our security services business.
strings.str_hsim_ambient_advantages_pla_1: Yeah, it must be very convenient.
strings.str_hsim_us_core_p1_05_im_18: M:A temporary period of slight adjustment
strings.str_hsim_us_core_p1_05_im_16: M:We simply need to ensure the consistency of certain standards and practises across our business interests
strings.str_hsim_us_core_p1_05_im_14: M:Yes, in line with the new requirements
strings.str_hsim_us_core_p1_05_im_12: M:Vrana Corp Industries feels it will be appropriate to post me here while Larkin Aviation gets up to speed
strings.str_hsim_us_core_p1_05_im_11: M:We're just trying to get the best out of the business
strings.str_hsim_us_core_p1_05_desc:
CIVIL AVIATION CONTRACT
Vrana Industries Incorporated, hereafter referred to as the COMPANY, and the CONTRACTOR hereby agree to enter into a new formal arrangement hereafter referred to as the CONTRACT.

The COMPANY requires the CONTRACTOR to transport William R J Haydon, hereafter referred to as the CLIENT, from the Vrana Corp HQ to the CLIENT's private airfield.

Failure to execute the terms of the CONTRACT within the agreed-upon time-frame (as defined separately in Annex II) will result in termination of the CONTRACT.
strings.str_hsim_us_core_p1_05_briefing.html_9: The client was delivered on time and you brought the new business manager to the heliport.
strings.str_hsim_us_core_p1_05_briefing.html_5: You interfered with Vrana helicopter operations.
strings.str_hsim_us_core_p1_05_briefing.html_3: You flew too rough for the client.
strings.str_hsim_us_core_p1_05_briefing.html_1: You did not deliver the client on time.
strings.str_hsim_whale_herd_spot.fsmfsm_states_s:
Film the group of whales by flying steadily in range and making sure Kelly can film out of the right side.

Maximum distance: %1

Caution: flying too close to the whales (within %2) may scare them under the surface.

Note: you can check your cockpit screen to see if Kelly is able to film the whales.
strings.str_hsim_us_core_p1_03_sum:
Fly down to meet our ocean-life contact, follow his directions and document any whale activity in the area.

J.
strings.str_hsim_us_core_p1_03_im_9: K:Oh, by the way, I met up with Derek later on for a drink - bit of an After Action Review.
strings.str_hsim_us_core_p1_03_im_6: K:But, in all seriousness, the flight today was enjoyable - even with that infernal racket!
strings.str_hsim_us_core_p1_03_im_3: K:Hmm, less of the 'old', if you please, Tom!
strings.str_hsim_ambient_gliders_pla_0: Sorry, what's that? I think I must have missed a beat, Kelly..!
strings.str_hsim_ambient_gliders_pla_1: Oh, really? ...and how did you come to that conclusion?
strings.str_hsim_ambient_gliders_sec_0: Y'know, sometimes, I like to think that's what dying will be like...
strings.str_hsim_ambient_gliders_sec_1: Gliders, I mean. Just gliding, peacefully. I guess that makes a helicopter hell.
strings.str_hsim_ambient_gliders_sec_2: Stands to reason, son. The noise that these things make. This infernal sound - just imagine - an eternity of it!
strings.str_hsim_ambient_gliders_sec_3: Y'know, son, they say helicopter's don't fly - they just beat the air into submission!
strings.str_hsim_ambient_preparation_pla_0: Oh, you're coming along for the ride?
strings.str_hsim_ambient_preparation_sec_0: Yeah, your brother seems to think it'll be a good idea...
strings.str_hsim_ambient_preparation_sec_2: I say, gliders... gliders are what I like best.
strings.str_hsim_ambient_preparation_sec_3: You can get really get some peace up there, y'know?
strings.str_hsim_us_core_p1_03_im_20: T:I've gotta shoot off. God talking.
strings.str_hsim_task_whales_bio_0: Ok, guys, let's stay in visual contact and start the survey.
strings.str_hsim_task_whales_bio_1: The important thing is to record any occurrences that we can: I need a number, a direction, and some basic estimate of size.
strings.str_hsim_task_whales_bio_2: Just be careful of your altitude, lads, or you'll drive them down before you've had half a chance to see them.
strings.str_hsim_task_herding_sec_0: Ok, now, just try to place us between it and the shore.
strings.str_hsim_task_herding_sec_1: Nice and easy, son - don't drop too low too quickly now, or you might scare him into more trouble...
strings.str_hsim_one_liners_positive_sec_1: Is that one coming up to the surface?
strings.str_hsim_one_liners_positive_sec_2: Over there, yeah, I think I've spotted one...
strings.str_hsim_one_liners_positive_sec_3: Alright, I've notified the coast guard. Assistance is on the way.
strings.str_hsim_one_liners_negative_bio_0: Lads, you're getting too close - you'll scare 'em away.
strings.str_hsim_one_liners_negative_bio_1: Try to stay close to the boat for the moment, guys.
strings.str_hsim_one_liners_negative_sec_1: Easy now, not too low, son.
strings.str_hsim_one_liners_negative_sec_2: Careful now, let's try to stick with the boat.
strings.str_hsim_one_liners_negative_sec_3: Let's try and stick close to the boat.
strings.str_hsim_one_liners_instructive_bio_0: I've had some reports of sightings, lads - I'll upload the data.
strings.str_hsim_one_liners_instructive_bio_1: Heads up, boys, we've got info about the whales close to your location.
strings.str_hsim_one_liners_instructive_bio_2: Check your map for the latest sightings, guys.
strings.str_hsim_one_liners_instructive_bio_3: Try to hold her steady - I'm trying to read the name of the boat...
strings.str_hsim_one_liners_instructive_bio_4: Alright, lads, great work. See if you can head out and find any more groups.
strings.str_hsim_oneliners_whales_bio_0: Alright, lads, I've spotted some movement. Check it out and try to get some steady footage! Out.
strings.str_hsim_oneliners_whales_bio_1: That's them diving down, lads. Seems like I can't spot any more from here; over.
strings.str_hsim_oneliners_whales_bio_2: Try gaining a little altitude and move up to see if you can spot anything. I'll keep an eye on my equipment here - guide you when I can; out.
strings.str_hsim_oneliners_whales_sec_0: There they are, Tom! Keep her steady, son. I'll do my best with this contraption!
strings.str_hsim_oneliners_whales_sec_1: Ok, just a little slower there, Tom... It's damned tough to focus properly...
strings.str_hsim_oneliners_whales_sec_2: Great work, son. I'm certain this'll do just fine!
strings.str_hsim_oneliners_whales_sec_3: Understood, Derek. What's the plan; over?
strings.str_hsim_feedback_herding_good_sec_0: It's working, Tom, ha, ha! The thing's shifting!
strings.str_hsim_feedback_herding_good_sec_1: Great job, son! Now let's get back on track, these whales won't film themselves..!
strings.str_hsim_feedback_herding_bad_sec_0: Ah, hell, Tom, I think we might be doing more harm that good...
strings.str_hsim_feedback_herding_bad_sec_1: Let's just back off. I'll send Derek the details - maybe he can sort it out.
strings.str_hsim_event_rendezvous_sec_0: Ok, son, I think I've spotted my buddy's boat there.
strings.str_hsim_event_rendezvous_sec_1: I'll call him and we can get started.
strings.str_hsim_event_job_done_pla_0: Thanks, Kelly, I appreciate it... and I appreciate you hooking us up with this one.
strings.str_hsim_event_job_done_sec_0: Alright, ok... I think that's enough for today. That was some great flying, Tom. I know your father would've been real proud.
strings.str_hsim_event_job_done_sec_1: Sure, Tom. But, honestly, we're going to need more than a little whale-watching to get us through this. No money in activism, son.
strings.str_hsim_event_herding_pla_0: Whoa, yeah, it's a big one!
strings.str_hsim_event_herding_pla_1: Right. Though, it seems to me like it's headed that way already...
strings.str_hsim_event_herding_sec_0: Tom, I think I see a shape down there - close to the shore...
strings.str_hsim_event_herding_sec_1: I guess - I dunno much about whales, but - it sure seems awful close to the shoreline there? I mean, we don't want it to wind up beached...
strings.str_hsim_event_herding_sec_2: Hell, y'know, it's not like I care so much, but... maybe there's something we can do?
strings.str_hsim_event_herding_sec_3: Maybe... maybe, we can try to drive it into deeper water; but, we risk panicking the damned thing into beaching itself...
strings.str_hsim_event_damaged_boat_pla_0: Sure, we should probably take a closer look.
strings.str_hsim_event_damaged_boat_sec_0: Watch out, Son, I think there's a boat in a bit of trouble over there...
strings.str_hsim_event_damaged_boat_sec_1: Exactly. Try to hold a hover nearby...
strings.str_hsim_event_damaged_boat_sec_2: I'll try to get the coast-guard some more details.
strings.str_hsim_event_cargo_pla_0: Whoa, you aren't kidding, huh? That really is a mess.
strings.str_hsim_event_cargo_sec_0: Hey, Tom, heads up: there's that cargo ship mess...
strings.str_hsim_event_cargo_sec_1: Yup... politically messy too. I mean... This has been going on since your brother's accident, Tom.
strings.str_hsim_event_cargo_sec_2: Apparently some kinda hazardous materials are causing all sorts of delays for the cleanup.
strings.str_hsim_event_beached_bio_0: Oh, you're joking? Ah, poor wee thing, that's a dammed tragedy.
strings.str_hsim_event_beached_bio_1: I'll notify Ocean Life Services immediately. Good work, though, lads.
strings.str_hsim_event_beached_sec_0: Hell, look over at the beach, Tom - seems like there's one actually beached itself, poor S.O.B...
strings.str_hsim_event_beached_pla_0: Oh, damn... you're right, Kelly. Yeah, that's a shame, huh?
strings.str_hsim_event_beached_sec_1: Sure is, son. I'll call Derek...
strings.str_hsim_event_beached_sec_2: Head's up, Derek, looks like we've got a beached whale up here at our position.
strings.str_hsim_ambient_task_pla_0: Not at all. Can't say I've actually seen a whale in real life...
strings.str_hsim_ambient_task_sec_0: Tell me, you ever done anything like this, son?
strings.str_hsim_ambient_rendezvous_bio_0: Ah, it's good to hear from you, Kelly, old man - and you, Tom!
strings.str_hsim_ambient_rendezvous_bio_1: Although, I don't know how you manage to keep that little chopper in the air with that fat old dog up there with ya!
strings.str_hsim_ambient_rendezvous_sec_0: Hello, Derek? Yeah, yeah, we're here at last!
strings.str_hsim_ambient_rendezvous_sec_1: Hold on, I'll patch you into the intercom...
strings.str_hsim_ambient_rendezvous_sec_2: Ok, you're on with Tom now, too.
strings.str_hsim_ambient_rendezvous_bio_2: Seriously, though, look, thanks for being a part of this survey.
strings.str_hsim_ambient_rendezvous_bio_3: Kelly should be a natural at this, though - after all, he's spent his life noting down useless details!
strings.str_hsim_ambient_rendezvous_sec_3: Ha, ha, Likewise, Derek. Ok, we're all set up here.
strings.str_hsim_ambient_opportunity_bro_1: Although, there'll be no 'upwards' at all if we sell all of our choppers!
strings.str_hsim_ambient_opportunity_bro_2: See? Now, that's the spirit - a little at a time - moving forward... moving upwards, right?
strings.str_hsim_ambient_opportunity_sec_0: There's some truth in that, Joe.
strings.str_hsim_ambient_opportunity_sec_1: So... look, uh, an old buddy of mine, works for the State Office of Sustainability and - whatever, some crap like that - mentioned something about a small job.
strings.str_hsim_ambient_opportunity_sec_2: Yeah, so - this guy, my buddy - he used to be biologist, see? Or an, uh, oceanologist maybe...
strings.str_hsim_ambient_opportunity_sec_3: Point being: the university have been tracking whales off the west coast for decades.
strings.str_hsim_ambient_opportunity_sec_4: My buddy, the school - and some deal with a British film and TV company - they're very interested in how this here Vrana Corp disaster is playing out.
strings.str_hsim_ambient_contract_bro_0: Kelly - I gotta be honest here, that sounds like quite a big deal, no? I mean... we talking... Attenborough here, or what?
strings.str_hsim_ambient_contract_bro_1: Well... whaddya' think to that, Tom?
strings.str_hsim_ambient_contract_bro_2: It's nothing much, granted, but, enough to cover the cost of our fuel at least, I'd say.
strings.str_hsim_ambient_contract_sec_0: Oh, I'm afraid it's not that all that exciting, boys...
strings.str_hsim_ambient_contract_sec_1: See, - right now - the state isn't exactly keen on paying-out on the half-chance of filming some skinny whale's behind.
strings.str_hsim_ambient_contract_sec_2: What my buddy needs is some hard, documented evidence - some facts.
strings.str_hsim_ambient_contract_sec_3: He's got a boat; we'd track him from the air - let him know if we spot anything.
strings.str_hsim_ambient_contract_bro_3: Great, it's settled, then. Kelly, call your man and tell him we're on board.
strings.str_hsim_ambient_contract_bro_4: Let's knock this one outta the park early this afternoon.
strings.str_hsim_ambient_contract_pla_0: Yeah, Joey. This sounds like a chance we should take, who knows what kind of opportunities could come out of it?
strings.str_hsim_ambient_activist_pla_0: Sure, I'd have to guess that local government isn't exactly keen to agitate a big business like Vrana Corp.
strings.str_hsim_ambient_activist_pla_1: And whales poisoned by hazardous materials isn't exactly great PR, right?
strings.str_hsim_ambient_activist_sec_0: Tom, you know, you shouldn't think me some loony activist. Not like Craymer, there!
strings.str_hsim_ambient_activist_sec_1: I mean, c'mon... whales? Nah, I owed my buddy here, Derek, a favour.
strings.str_hsim_ambient_activist_sec_2: Derek is just all fired-up trying to get some cash poured into this here plan.
strings.str_hsim_ambient_activist_sec_3: I mean, yeah - the State Office is keen to appear to be doing something good for a change - but there's just no funding.
strings.str_hsim_ambient_activist_sec_4: Hell, Tom, if you go on like that, you'll wind up a grizzled old cynic like me.
strings.str_hsim_us_core_p1_03_im_2: T:Hey, old man, how'd you enjoy the flight?
strings.str_hsim_us_core_p1_03_im_19: T:Sure, I know that. We are. I think...
strings.str_hsim_us_core_p1_03_im_18: K:The important thing is that he has a focus - he needs to feel like he is moving the business forward
strings.str_hsim_us_core_p1_03_im_16: K:Not being able to pilot these birds? It is a kick in the teeth - there is just no getting past that fact.
strings.str_hsim_us_core_p1_03_im_15: K:The accident was a real blow - particularly coming so soon after your father, of course.
strings.str_hsim_us_core_p1_03_im_14: T:And... how do you think he's holding up?
strings.str_hsim_us_core_p1_03_im_13: K:You just concentrate on your flying. Your brother is passionate about taking on this business role.
strings.str_hsim_us_core_p1_03_im_12: K:Yes, but don't you concern yourself with that, son - Joe has got it all under control.
strings.str_hsim_us_core_p1_03_im_11: T:Good news... we're sure in need of it.
strings.str_hsim_us_core_p1_03_im_10: K:He asked me to thank you for your help. He is hopeful about sending more work our way!
strings.str_hsim_us_core_p1_03_desc:
Hey, Tom,
Kelly's contact with the state is keen to get moving re: the whales. His name's Derek Moriarty; he's got a small boat harboured in the locality, and has agreed to meet with you there.

From Derek's emails, it seems as though it'll be a simple enough flight. It's all a bit informal, but, basically, you should follow his instructions, searching and documenting any sign of cetacea (that's whales to you!) that you may come across.

Couple key things: hold steady for capturing any footage you can, and ensure you don't drop too close to the surface. There are several regulations about how much distance you need to maintain to keep from scaring them. I'll send over more documentation as it becomes available.

Joe.
strings.str_hsim_us_core_p1_03_briefing.html_7: You were able to get good footage of whales in the bay.
strings.str_hsim_us_core_p1_03_briefing.html_1: You failed to follow the boat.
strings.str_hsim_us_core_p1_02_sum:
I've explained today's task in more detail, but the top and bottom of it remains simple: fly the buyer to his compound, and ensure that he enjoys the flight!

J.
strings.str_hsim_us_core_p1_02_im_7: C:Um, maybe a framed one for the workshop?
strings.str_hsim_us_core_p1_02_im_6: T:Ah, yeah. It's a shame. Plans for them?
strings.str_hsim_us_core_p1_02_im_5: C:Just sorting through some old snaps of the chopper we off-loaded today...
strings.str_hsim_us_core_p1_02_im_3: C:Oh, y'know, not much, not much!
strings.str_hsim_us_core_p1_02_im_20: C:Yeah, Tommy, yeah - I think you're gonna fit in here just fine!
strings.str_hsim_us_core_p1_02_im_17: T:Hah, whatever you say, man - I was too busy trying not to crash!
strings.str_hsim_ambient_midflight_1_ceo_0: How is this economy treating your business, Mr Larkin?
strings.str_hsim_ambient_midflight_1_ceo_1: I see, yes, and your brother, Joe, he cannot fly any more, as I understand.
strings.str_hsim_ambient_midflight_1_pla_0: Times are tough for everyone, sir. We get by.
strings.str_hsim_ambient_midflight_1_ceo_3: Please excuse me, however, I must briefly answer an email.
strings.str_hsim_ambient_midflight_1_pla_1: You seem to understand a great many things, Mr Haydon.
strings.str_hsim_ambient_midflight_2_ceo_0: My apologies. So, getting back to the matter at hand...
strings.str_hsim_ambient_midflight_2_ceo_1: Your brother's accident was widely reported; it was only a week ago that he was in the water below us, afterall.
strings.str_hsim_ambient_midflight_2_ceo_2: And with the loss of the late Mr Larkin, I hope a such small business is able to... adapt.
strings.str_hsim_ambient_midflight_2_ceo_3: Yes. It is a terrible business - a great mess, indeed. Impossible to forecast; shortly to be resolved, we all pray.
strings.str_hsim_ambient_midflight_2_pla_0: Yes, thank you, Mr Haydon. He is recovering well, as is Larkin Aviation.
strings.str_hsim_ambient_midflight_2_pla_1: The economy isn't in great shape, certainly. This cargo disaster's done nothing to improve the mood in the city, either.
strings.str_hsim_task_yaght_ceo_0: I say, Mr Larkin, could you deviate from our course somewhat?
strings.str_hsim_task_yaght_ceo_1: No, not at all, not at all!
strings.str_hsim_task_yaght_ceo_2: You see, an acquaintance has recently invested in a new Yacht.
strings.str_hsim_task_yaght_pla_0: Uh, well, that depends - is there a problem, Mr Haydon?
strings.str_hsim_task_yaght_ceo_3: Quite simply, I thought we might take a quick fly-over?
strings.str_hsim_event_yaght_ceo_0: Oh, I'd hardly describe it as a 'boat'.
strings.str_hsim_event_yaght_mec_0: Oh, uh, I think there's a boat down there, Mr Haydon. Is that the one?
strings.str_hsim_event_yaght_mec_1: Well, it's floating on the water...
strings.str_hsim_event_yaght_pla_0: Nothing, Mr Haydon, let's move to your compound, ok?
strings.str_hsim_event_take_off_ceo_0: You have a very well positioned Heliport, Mr Larkin. Very well positioned, indeed.
strings.str_hsim_event_take_off_ceo_1: Yes, your father. I was sorry to hear of his passing.
strings.str_hsim_event_take_off_ceo_2: Certainly, he was a well-respected man - a very traditional man. Of course, anyone with the slightest understanding of the aviation business knew of Harry Larkin.
strings.str_hsim_event_take_off_pla_0: Thanks, yeah, Highland Park's been in the family since the late 70's. Dad took it from no more than a warehouse to what it is today.
strings.str_hsim_event_take_off_ceo_3: I know enough, Mr Larkin. Let us proceed to my compound.
strings.str_hsim_event_take_off_pla_2: And you know about the business, sir?
strings.str_hsim_event_buzzer_bro_0: Ok, that'll be Kelly, the buyer must already be here.
strings.str_hsim_event_buzzer_bro_1: Hey, Tom, c'mon, don't look so worried.
strings.str_hsim_event_buzzer_bro_2: Look, just get your things together. He'll meet you out front in five minutes.
strings.str_hsim_event_approach_ceo_0: Yes, it is a fine machine. A... 'classic' by anyone's judgement.
strings.str_hsim_event_approach_ceo_1: Most certainly, gentleman. Touch us down and we shall come to an arrangement.
strings.str_hsim_event_approach_mec_0: How'd'ya enjoy the flight, Mr Haydon? She's a real beauty, huh?
strings.str_hsim_event_approach_mec_1: The beat of that engine - the blades - it's... oh, it's poetic, right?
strings.str_hsim_event_approach_pla_0: So, you'd like to discuss terms, sir?
strings.str_hsim_ambient_whales_ceo_0: Come now, Mr Craymer, I wouldn't believe all you read on those internet forums.
strings.str_hsim_ambient_whales_mec_0: Y'know, Tom, there's been a lot of talk of whales in the area - yeah, even as far south as this!
strings.str_hsim_ambient_whales_mec_1: Best guess is that cargo disaster is messing with their, uh, natural rhythms, y'know? It's a real shame.
strings.str_hsim_ambient_whales_pla_0: Sure, right, I'll have to keep an eye open, Craymer.
strings.str_hsim_ambient_radio_intro_new_0: ...And with the spill of hazardous material containers showing no sign of improvement, local groups have called upon Vrana Corp to do more to prevent damage to both small businesses and wildlife in the area.
strings.str_hsim_ambient_radio_intro_new_1: I'm Don Kinsley, giving Seattle the news on the hour, every hour. You're listening to 97.1, KBBC-attle Radio: tune it, in turn it up, and rip off that knob.
strings.str_hsim_ambient_post_flight_ceo_0: Gentlemen, I thank you. It was an enjoyable flight. I would be pleased to accept the sum I discussed with your brother.
strings.str_hsim_ambient_post_flight_ceo_1: Then it is settled. I can arrange for a driver to take you back to your heliport. I insist.
strings.str_hsim_ambient_post_flight_ceo_2: Certainly, certainly. My staff will be able to direct you towards the main entrance.
strings.str_hsim_ambient_post_flight_pla_0: Certainly, Mr Haydon. It's a fair price.
strings.str_hsim_ambient_post_flight_ceo_3: It has been a pleasure doing business with you, Mr Larkin. Good day to you both.
strings.str_hsim_ambient_post_flight_pla_1: No, sir, thank you, but, that won't be necessary. We're able to make our own way back.
strings.str_hsim_ambient_post_flight_pla_2: Not a word, Craymer. Not a word.
strings.str_hsim_ambient_ceo_ceo_0: It is a pleasure to meet you, Tom, I'm sure. My name is William Haydon - I understand that you're to be my pilot today.
strings.str_hsim_ambient_ceo_ceo_1: Excellent, excellent. A fine opportunity. Please, let us waste no further time, then, and get straight to the business of flying.
strings.str_hsim_ambient_ceo_pla_0_0: Yeah, yes, that's right - give you a chance to see how the bird handles, sir.
strings.str_hsim_ambient_ceo_pla_1_0: Sure, um, let's get in the air.
strings.str_hsim_ambient_buyer_bro_0: Well, seems like there is a bit of good news...
strings.str_hsim_ambient_buyer_bro_1: A private buyer has made a move for one of our choppers.
strings.str_hsim_ambient_buyer_mec_0: The bird's ready boss. Ready as she'll ever be, anyway. That's for sure. Fuelled up and ready to go.
strings.str_hsim_ambient_buyer_pla_0: What's that, Joe? What's going on?
strings.str_hsim_ambient_buyer_bro_2: Y'know, it's not ideal, but, this'll give us the quick injection of cash we need to keep our heads above water.
strings.str_hsim_ambient_buyer_bro_3: Uh, yeah, I was just getting to that. The buyer wants a test flight - to see how the old lady handles...
strings.str_hsim_ambient_buyer_bro_4: I said that wouldn't be a problem. In fact, I was so confident he'd like her, I proposed that you'd personally fly him back to his compound in the bird.
strings.str_hsim_ambient_buyer_pla_1: Sure, ok, but... what's going on exactly?
strings.str_hsim_ambient_boarding_mec_0: Here, Mr Haydon, you should ride up front with Tom. You can get a better feel for the bird up there. That's for sure. Great view of the city, too.
strings.str_hsim_ambient_boarding_mec_1: I'll be heading up with you. I'll be able to answer any technical questions you might have, Mr. Haydon. Any at all, just let me know.
strings.str_hsim_ambient_boarding_mec_2: She's a real fine bird, Mr Haydon, real fine. These ones always are. That's a fact. Top condition, too. Just Listen. You can already hear that she'll be a pleasure to fly.
strings.str_hsim_ambient_boarding_mec_3: Ok, Tom, let's take her, up, show Mr Haydon here what she's capable of. Would you just listen to that engine - it's a symphony, isn't it?
strings.str_hsim_us_core_p1_02_im_15: C:If you don't mind me saying, that buyer seemed a bit... up himself, y'know?
strings.str_hsim_us_core_p1_02_im_14: C:Oh, yeah, that's for sure. It's just a pity we had to get rid of the bird!
strings.str_hsim_us_core_p1_02_im_13: T:I enjoyed the flight today - was my flying alright?
strings.str_hsim_us_core_p1_02_im_12: T:No, I know, I know. I remember dad talking about it.
strings.str_hsim_us_core_p1_02_im_11: C:Y'know, that old bird's been with L.A. from waaaay back in the day!
strings.str_hsim_us_core_p1_02_desc:
Hey, Bro,
It looks like we've got a chance to get you up and running. Today's flight is a simple one, but, it's pretty important.

A buyer is interested in purchasing one of our choppers; you're tasked to provide a demonstration flight - let him see how the old bird handles. Transport him to his compound, and, Tom, try to give him a smooth flight!

Look, we're really in a jam at the moment, so every dollar we can get for this asset is vital to our cash-flow. I've got complete faith in you on this one. Knock it out the park, bro.

Joe.
strings.str_hsim_us_core_p1_02_briefing.html_6: You've landed at the buyer's compound and he agreed to buy the helicopter.
strings.str_hsim_us_mil_03_sum: You're tasked to distribute information leaflets across several key locations.
strings.str_hsim_07_crashed_bro_0: Captain Pierce, sir! Captain Pierce!? Damnit!
strings.str_hsim_07_crashed_bro_1: Yeah, received - this is... go ahead, Battlemage.
strings.str_hsim_07_crashed_mil_1: We've got activity around your grid, possibly hostile; find cover, quickly; CAS is inbound.
strings.str_hsim_one_liners_cas_0: Whisky-6; this is Warhorse-2-0; We're your CAS - keep your head down!
strings.str_hsim_10_mil_outro_bro_1_0: Y'know, I was lucky to make it out in one piece. It still tears me up that the same can't be said for Capitan Pierce...
strings.str_hsim_10_mil_outro_pla_0_0: Christ, Joe. I had no idea - I mean, I knew you were shot down, but - that's...
strings.str_hsim_09_pickup_bro_0: Wait, no, you've - we've got to recover Captain Pierce - he may still have a chance!
strings.str_hsim_09_pickup_bro_1: What? No! No, we're not leaving a man behind!
strings.str_hsim_09_pickup_pmc_1: No can do! We're only contracted to pick up foot-mobile survivors! No expections.
strings.str_hsim_09_pickup_pmc_2: Negative. We have our orders. We've got no defensive capability; we're practically a taxi service.
strings.str_hsim_08_exfiltrate_mil_1: All our evac choppers are tied up. We're deploying contractors to extract you.
strings.str_hsim_08_exfiltrate_mil_2: Move towards the extract-point 'Skipper' and avoid further contact. Good luck, Larkin; Battlemage out.
strings.str_hsim_06_event_shotdown_cop_0: Great work, J-Dog - that's First Class flying. Now, take us up to our final drop-zone.
strings.str_hsim_06_event_shotdown_cop_1: We've got incoming! Brace for impact!
strings.str_hsim_06_event_shotdown_cop_2: Mayday, Mayday! This is Whisky-6 going down, I say again, Whisky-6 going down! Acknowledge, over!
strings.str_hsim_06_event_shotdown_cop_3: Ok, take us down! Easy as you can!
